priority_order: Replay HVI-CIDNet, DarkIR and the source-matched Retinexformer in the fixed current scoring environment
Implement/audit AMNet RGB reference; record pretraining provenance
Resolve recent-neighbor model availability; add measurements only for actual complete reproducible models
comparison_rules: Core6 is the working comparison roster, not a claim that six models are already verified under one environment
Do not remove strong references based on unfavorable scores
Separate matched-source training from released models with different or unknown training data
For SDSD-to-BVI transfer claims, exclude target-domain optimization and verify training membership; previously seen BVI VAL is development, not a globally blind target
Keep native full-video benchmark claims separate from the centre16/crop256 development protocol
Do not mix source float-RGB 28.71dB pilot scores with target uint8 PSNR-Y scores
No GT-derived brightness/histogram adjustment in primary output metrics
Internal raw_node/trajectory/memory/geometry controls are ablations, not external SOTA methods
BVI-RLV and BVI-lowlight names must be resolved by dataset provenance rather than assumed identical
Historical image-reference GT-tLP drift is a replay reason, not evidence that their multi-dB advantage is an evaluation artifact

innovation_status.positive_existing_evidence: Aligned actual-observation values help relative to matched same-frame/mismatched controls; this does not establish a new operator or SOTA

next_module_hypothesis.name: Source-calibrated joint observation correspondence
next_module_hypothesis.mechanism: Jointly score correspondence candidates from multiple donor frames with descriptor cost, observable consistency and calibrated effective observation-error scales; transport actual observed detail; fall back when ambiguous
next_module_hypothesis.novelty_boundary: Joint inference, uncertainty weighting, prior conditioning and observation transport all have precedents; a defensible specific contribution requires nearest-work differentiation and positive mechanism controls
required_controls: joint versus independent correspondence with matched candidate/input/optimization budget
video-prior versus matched pixel descriptors and correspondence-destroying control
